statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = (y + 7)\vec j through a square of side 4 in the xz-plane, oriented in the negative y-direction.

static.solution: S, is in the plane y=0 and oriented in the negative y-direction, d\vec A=-\vec j dx\, dz and \int_S\vec F\cdot d\vec A=\int_S(0+7)\vec j\cdot (-\vec j dx \,dz)=-7\int_S dx\, dz = -7\cdot \mbox{Area of square }= -7(4^2) = -112.
